newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Jensen ups Boise Cascade.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Jensen ups Boise Cascade.

text.p: -- Jensen Securities analyst Steven Dietrich said he upgraded Boise Cascade Corp to outperform from neutral and boosted his earnings estimates for 1997 and 1998.

-- The analyst said he expected the paper products company to report earnings of $0.50 per share in fiscal 1997, up from $0.20 per share previously, and earnings of $2.75 per share in fiscal 1998, up from his prior $1.50 a share view.

-- The analyst said the higher earnings forecasts were predicated on expected benefits from lower paper segment operating costs. The industry has been weathering a period of lower paper and packaging prices.
-- He said Boise has made steady progress in exiting lower value paper markets and reducing its long-term debt with the proceeds from asset sales.
